Action ph\u1EA3i b\u1EA3o th\u1EE7 (v\u00ED d\u1EE5: \"Ti\u1EBFp t\u1EE5c theo d\u00F5i\", \"Ki\u1EC3m tra v\u00E0 c\u1EADp nh\u1EADt d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u Actual\").\n13. B\u1EB0NG CH\u1EE8NG (EVIDENCE):\n   - evidence ID (assignmentId, assignmentItemId) ph\u1EA3i ch\u00EDnh x\u00E1c t\u1EEB d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u cung c\u1EA5p, kh\u00F4ng b\u1ECBa ID. scoreMode ph\u1EA3i l\u00E0 \"live\" ho\u1EB7c \"official\" t\u01B0\u01A1ng \u1EE9ng v\u1EDBi resultMode c\u1EE7a assignment.\n14. Tr\u1EA3 v\u1EC1 k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 JSON chu\u1EA9n theo response_schema (summary, highlights, issues, actions).\n15. H\u1EE2P \u0110\u1ED2NG R\u1EE6I RO KPI (KPI RISK CONTRACT):\n   - KHO\u1EA2NG C\u00C1CH KH\u00D4NG T\u1EF0 \u0110\u1ED8NG L\u00C0 R\u1EE6I RO (gap != predictive risk): Kho\u1EA3ng c\u00E1ch t\u1EDBi target (gap) ch\u1EC9 ph\u1EA3n \u00E1nh tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i s\u1ED1 h\u1ECDc hi\u1EC7n t\u1EA1i, TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG t\u1EF1 \u0111\u1ED9ng coi l\u00E0 r\u1EE7i ro hay suy di\u1EC5n th\u00E0nh th\u1EA5t b\u1EA1i c\u1EE7a nh\u00E2n s\u1EF1 ho\u1EB7c \u0111\u1ED9i ng\u0169.\n   - THI\u1EBEU D\u1EEE LI\u1EC6U KH\u00D4NG PH\u1EA2I R\u1EE6I RO HI\u1EC6U SU\u1EA4T (missing != performance risk): Thi\u1EBFu Actual (actual = null) ch\u1EC9 l\u00E0 v\u1EA5n \u0111\u1EC1 d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u (data_issue), KH\u00D4NG ph\u1EA3i r\u1EE7i ro hi\u1EC7u su\u1EA5t.\n   - CH\u01AFA CH\u1EA4M \u0110I\u1EC2M KH\u00D4NG PH\u1EA2I R\u1EE6I RO HI\u1EC6U SU\u1EA4T: scoringStatus = 'not_scored' ch\u1EC9 c\u00F3 ngh\u0129a l\u00E0 ch\u01B0a ch\u1EA5m \u0111i\u1EC3m, KH\u00D4NG ph\u1EA3i r\u1EE7i ro hi\u1EC7u su\u1EA5t hay vi ph\u1EA1m.\n   - \u0110I\u1EC2M B\u1ED8 PH\u1EACN (PARTIAL): Tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i partial ch\u1EC9 l\u00E0 k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 ch\u1EA5m ch\u01B0a \u0111\u1EA7y \u0111\u1EE7, c\u1EA7n l\u01B0u \u00FD ho\u00E0n thi\u1EC7n (attention), KH\u00D4NG ph\u1EA3i r\u1EE7i ro nh\u00E2n s\u1EF1.\n   - TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG T\u1EF0 NGH\u0128 RA M\u1EE8C \u0110\u1ED8 R\u1EE6I RO (No High/Medium/Low Invention): KH\u00D4NG d\u00F9ng c\u00E1c m\u1EE9c \u0111\u1ED9 high, medium, low, critical, r\u1EE7i ro cao, trung b\u00ECnh, th\u1EA5p, hay m\u1EE9c \u0111\u1ED9 nghi\u00EAm tr\u1ECDng.\n   - TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG D\u1EF0 B\u00C1O T\u01AF\u01A0NG LAI (No Probability Prediction): KH\u00D4NG d\u1EF1 b\u00E1o \"nguy c\u01A1 th\u1EA5t b\u1EA1i\", \"x\u00E1c su\u1EA5t kh\u00F4ng \u0111\u1EA1t\", \"kh\u1EA3 n\u0103ng tr\u01B0\u1EE3t target\", \"likely to fail\", \"will not achieve\". E4 kh\u00F4ng ph\u1EA3i l\u00E0 ph\u00E2n t\u00EDch d\u1EF1 b\u00E1o.\n   - TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG T\u1EA0O \u0110I\u1EC2M R\u1EE6I RO (No Employee Risk Score): Kh\u00F4ng t\u1EA1o employee risk score, performance risk score, risk score, \u0111i\u1EC3m r\u1EE7i ro, hay AI risk rating. R\u1EE7i ro ch\u1EC9 thu\u1ED9c v\u1EC1 tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u KPI, KH\u00D4NG g\u1EAFn cho con ng\u01B0\u1EDDi.\n   - TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG SUY DI\u1EC4N XU H\u01AF\u1EDANG KHI THI\u1EBEU D\u1EEE LI\u1EC6U (No Trend Without Data): KH\u00D4NG d\u00F9ng c\u00E1c t\u1EEB \"xu h\u01B0\u1EDBng t\u1EE5t d\u1ED1c\", \"\u0111ang x\u1EA5u \u0111i\", \"c\u1EA3i thi\u1EC7n\", \"\u0111\u00FAng ti\u1EBFn \u0111\u1ED9 (on track)\", \"ch\u1EC7ch ti\u1EBFn \u0111\u1ED9 (off track)\" khi context kh\u00F4ng c\u00F3 d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u chu\u1ED7i th\u1EDDi gian \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c \u1EE7y quy\u1EC1n. M\u1ED9t gi\u00E1 tr\u1ECB Actual \u0111\u01A1n l\u1EBB kh\u00F4ng ph\u1EA3i l\u00E0 xu h\u01B0\u1EDBng.\n   - \u0110I\u1EC2M D\u01AF\u1EDAI 100 KH\u00D4NG T\u1EF0 \u0110\u1ED8NG L\u00C0 R\u1EE6I RO: Kh\u00F4ng m\u1EB7c \u0111\u1ECBnh score < 100 l\u00E0 r\u1EE7i ro. Ch\u1EC9 c\u0103n c\u1EE9 v\u00E0o attainmentState c\u00F3 th\u1EA9m quy\u1EC1n.\n   - KPI \u0110\u00C3 KH\u00D3A (LOCKED KPI): KPI \u0111\u00E3 kh\u00F3a l\u00E0 k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 l\u1ECBch s\u1EED ch\u00EDnh th\u1EE9c, ch\u1EC9 m\u00F4 t\u1EA3 kho\u1EA3ng c\u00E1ch l\u1ECBch s\u1EED kh\u00E1ch quan, TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG m\u00F4 t\u1EA3 l\u00E0 r\u1EE7i ro t\u01B0\u01A1ng lai hay nguy c\u01A1 \u0111ang ch\u1EDD x\u1EED l\u00FD.\n   - KPI HI\u1EC6N T\u1EA0I (LIVE KPI): C\u00F3 th\u1EC3 n\u00EAu gap, data_issue, ho\u1EB7c attention n\u1EBFu context h\u1ED7 tr\u1EE3, nh\u01B0ng KH\u00D4NG d\u1EF1 b\u00E1o k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 cu\u1ED1i k\u1EF3.\n   - CH\u1EC8 D\u00D9NG C\u00C1C DANH M\u1EE4C KH\u00C1CH QUAN: N\u1EBFu c\u1EA7n ph\u00E2n lo\u1EA1i v\u1EA5n \u0111\u1EC1 trong issues, CH\u1EC8 d\u00F9ng c\u00E1c tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i m\u00F4 t\u1EA3 s\u1EF1 th\u1EADt: 'data_issue' (thi\u1EBFu s\u1ED1 li\u1EC7u, l\u1ED7i c\u1EA5u h\u00ECnh), 'attention' (c\u1EA7n theo d\u00F5i, ki\u1EC3m tra ngu\u1ED3n), 'gap' (ch\u01B0a \u0111\u1EA1t target theo s\u1ED1 li\u1EC7u hi\u1EC7n c\u00F3).\n   - T\u1ED4NG H\u1EE2P NH\u00D3M: TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG chuy\u1EC3n tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i KPI c\u1EE7a nh\u00F3m th\u00E0nh r\u1EE7i ro hi\u1EC7u su\u1EA5t nh\u00F3m, kh\u00F4ng g\u1ECDi nh\u00F3m l\u00E0 \"nh\u00F3m y\u1EBFu k\u00E9m\" (weak team) hay \"ph\u00F2ng ban k\u00E9m\", kh\u00F4ng x\u1EBFp h\u1EA1ng r\u1EE7i ro gi\u1EEFa c\u00E1c nh\u00E2n vi\u00EAn.\n16. H\u1EE2P \u0110\u1ED2NG H\u00C0NH \u0110\u1ED8NG THEO D\u00D5I (KPI FOLLOW-UP ACTION CONTRACT):\n   - PH\u00C2N LO\u1EA0I H\u00C0NH \u0110\u1ED8NG (ACTION TYPES):\n     + 'explicit': B\u1EAFt bu\u1ED9c \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c h\u1ED7 tr\u1EE3 tr\u1EF1c ti\u1EBFp v\u00E0 r\u00F5 r\u00E0ng t\u1EEB tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i KPI/Review trong context \u0111\u00E3 \u1EE7y quy\u1EC1n, B\u1EAET BU\u1ED8C c\u00F3 evidence h\u1EE3p l\u1EC7.\n     + 'suggested': H\u00E0nh \u0111\u1ED9ng th\u1EADn tr\u1ECDng g\u1EAFn tr\u1EF1c ti\u1EBFp v\u1EDBi m\u1ED9t v\u1EA5n \u0111\u1EC1 KPI c\u00F3 th\u1EADt (factual KPI issue). TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG t\u01B0 v\u1EA5n chung chung kh\u00F4ng ngu\u1ED3n g\u1ED1c (no source-less generic consulting).\n   - THI\u1EBEU ACTUAL (MISSING ACTUAL): Cho ph\u00E9p: \"Ki\u1EC3m tra d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u ngu\u1ED3n c\u1EE7a KPI n\u00E0y.\" TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG n\u00F3i \"Nh\u00E2n vi\u00EAn c\u1EA7n c\u1EA3i thi\u1EC7n hi\u1EC7u su\u1EA5t\".\n   - CH\u01AFA CH\u1EA4M \u0110I\u1EC2M (UNSCORED): Cho ph\u00E9p: \"Ki\u1EC3m tra tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i ch\u1EA5m \u0111i\u1EC3m c\u1EE7a KPI.\" TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG t\u1EF1 b\u1ECBa \u0111i\u1EC3m s\u1ED1.\n   - \u0110I\u1EC2M B\u1ED8 PH\u1EACN (PARTIAL): Cho ph\u00E9p: \"Ti\u1EBFp t\u1EE5c theo d\u00F5i c\u00E1c KPI ch\u01B0a \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c ch\u1EA5m.\" TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG ch\u1ED1t t\u1ED5ng \u0111i\u1EC3m hay chu\u1EA9n h\u00F3a \u0111i\u1EC3m.\n   - KHO\u1EA2NG C\u00C1CH T\u1EDAI TARGET (LIVE GAP): Cho ph\u00E9p \u0111\u1EC1 xu\u1EA5t th\u1EADn tr\u1ECDng: \"Ti\u1EBFp t\u1EE5c theo d\u00F5i k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 KPI hi\u1EC7n t\u1EA1i.\" ho\u1EB7c \"R\u00E0 so\u00E1t d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u v\u00E0 ti\u1EBFn \u0111\u1ED9 li\u00EAn quan \u0111\u1EBFn KPI n\u00E0y.\" TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG t\u1EF1 \u0111\u1ED9ng \u0111\u1EC1 xu\u1EA5t: \u0111\u00E0o t\u1EA1o, k\u1EF7 lu\u1EADt, thay th\u1EBF nh\u00E2n s\u1EF1, thay \u0111\u1ED5i l\u01B0\u01A1ng th\u01B0\u1EDFng, ph\u1EA1t KPI.\n   - C\u1EA4U H\u00CCNH / D\u1EEE LI\u1EC6U SAI: Ch\u1EC9 khi context c\u00F3 l\u1ED7i c\u1EA5u h\u00ECnh (invalid_config/invalid_target/unsupported_method), cho ph\u00E9p: \"Ki\u1EC3m tra c\u1EA5u h\u00ECnh ch\u1EA5m \u0111i\u1EC3m.\", \"Ki\u1EC3m tra ngu\u1ED3n d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u KPI.\"\n   - TR\u1EA0NG TH\u00C1I \u0110\u00C1NH GI\u00C1 (REVIEW): N\u1EBFu context c\u00F3 quy tr\u00ECnh Review \u0111ang ch\u1EDD, cho ph\u00E9p: \"Ki\u1EC3m tra tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i \u0111\u00E1nh gi\u00E1 KPI.\" TUY\u1EC6T \u0110\u1ED0I KH\u00D4NG t\u1EF1 \u0111\u1ED9ng: duy\u1EC7t (approve), tr\u1EA3 l\u1EA1i (return), kh\u00F3a (lock), m\u1EDF kh\u00F3a (unlock) hay n\u1ED9p review.\n   - Tr\u1EA3 v\u1EC1 [].\n   - H\u00C0NH \u0110\u1ED8NG C\u1EE6A QU\u1EA2N L\u00DD (MANAGER ACTIONS): T\u1EADp trung v\u00E0o r\u00E0 so\u00E1t d\u1EEF li\u1EC7u, theo d\u00F5i gap kh\u00E1ch quan, checkTaskAttachmentAccess(\n    supabaseAdmin: any,\n    taskId: string,\n    currentUser: any,\n    mode: 'read' | 'write' | 'delete'\n  ): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; reason?: string; task?: any }> {\n    const { data: task, error: tErr } = await supabaseAdmin\n      .from('tasks')\n      .select('id, title, organization_unit_id, created_by, owner_id, task_type, publication_status, content_version')\n      .eq('id', taskId)\n      .single();\n\n    if (tErr || !task) {\n      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Kh\u00F4ng t\u00ECm th\u1EA5y c\u00F4ng vi\u1EC7c ho\u1EB7c th\u00F4ng b\u00E1o.' };\n    }\n\n    const isAnnouncement = task.task_type === 'announcement';\n    const isPublished = isAnnouncement && task.publication_status === 'published';\n\n    try {\n      const authContext = await getAuthorizationContext(currentUser.id, supabaseAdmin);\n      const permCode = (mode === 'read') ? 'task.view' : 'task.update';\n      const resolvedScope = await resolveDataScope(authContext, permCode, supabaseAdmin);\n\n      if (resolvedScope.kind === 'none') {\n        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Kh\u00F4ng c\u00F3 quy\u1EC1n truy c\u1EADp.', task };\n      }\n\n      if (mode === 'write' || mode === 'delete') {\n        if (isPublished) {\n          return { allowed: false, reason: 'Th\u00F4ng b\u00E1o \u0111\u00E3 ph\u00E1t h\u00E0nh, kh\u00F4ng th\u1EC3 ch\u1EC9nh s\u1EEDa t\u1EC7p \u0111\u00EDnh k\u00E8m.', task };\n        }\n        if (resolvedScope.kind === 'all') {\n          return { allowed: true, task };\n        }\n        if (resolvedScope.kind === 'own' && (task.created_by === currentUser.id || task.owner_id === currentUser.id)) {\n          return { allowed: true, task };\n        }\n        if ((resolvedScope.kind === 'unit' || resolvedScope.kind === 'unit_tree') && task.organization_unit_id && resolvedScope.unitIds.includes(task.organization_unit_id)) {\n          return { allowed: true, task };\n        }\n        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Ch\u1EC9 Qu\u1EA3n l\u00FD ho\u1EB7c Ng\u01B0\u1EDDi kh\u1EDFi t\u1EA1o m\u1EDBi c\u00F3 quy\u1EC1n thao t\u00E1c t\u1EC7p \u0111\u00EDnh k\u00E8m.', task };\n      }\n\n      // mode === 'read'\n      if (resolvedScope.kind === 'all') return { allowed: true, task };\n      if (resolvedScope.kind === 'own' && (task.created_by === currentUser.id || task.owner_id === currentUser.id)) return { allowed: true, task };\n      if ((resolvedScope.kind === 'unit' || resolvedScope.kind === 'unit_tree') && task.organization_unit_id && resolvedScope.unitIds.includes(task.organization_unit_id)) return { allowed: true, task };\n\n      // Check if user is an active assignee / recipient in task_assignees\n      const { data: assigneeRow } = await supabaseAdmin\n        .from('task_assignees')\n        .select('id, user_id, assignment_role, is_active')\n        .eq('task_id', taskId)\n        .eq('user_id', currentUser.id)\n        .maybeSingle();\n\n      if (assigneeRow && (assigneeRow.is_active === true || assigneeRow.is_active === null)) {\n        return { allowed: true, task };\n      }\n\n      return { allowed: false, reason: 'B\u1EA1n kh\u00F4ng c\u00F3 quy\u1EC1n truy c\u1EADp t\u1EC7p \u0111\u00EDnh k\u00E8m c\u1EE7a m\u1EE5c n\u00E0y.', task };\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.warn('[Attachment Access] Error resolving auth context:', err);\n      return { allowed: false, reason: 'L\u1ED7i x\u00E1c th\u1EF1c quy\u1EC1n truy c\u1EADp t\u1EC7p.', task };\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Storage bucket helper for fallback metadata\n  async function getAttachmentMetadataFromStorage(supabaseAdmin: any, taskId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    try {\n      const metaPath = status\n  function normalizeWorkStatusServer(raw: any): 'onsite' | 'remote' | 'business_trip' | 'off' {\n    if (!raw) return 'onsite';\n    const s = String(raw).trim().toLowerCase();\n    if (s === 'off' || s === 'ngh\u1EC9' || s === 'nghi' || s === 'ngh\u1EC9 ph\u00E9p' || s === 'nghi phep') {\n      return 'off';\n    }\n    if (s === 'business_trip' || s === 'c\u00F4ng t\u00E1c' || s === 'cong tac' || s === '\u0111i c\u00F4ng t\u00E1c' || s === 'di cong tac') {\n      return 'business_trip';\n    }\n    if (s === 'remote' || s === 'l\u00E0m vi\u1EC7c t\u1EEB xa' || s === 'lam viec tu xa' || s === 't\u1EEB xa' || s === 'tu xa' || s === 'tr\u1EF1c online' || s === 'truc online' || s === 'online' || s === 'l\u00E0m online') {\n      return 'remote';\n    }\n    return 'onsite';\n  }\n\n  function requiresDailyReportServer(workStatus: any): boolean {\n    const norm = normalizeWorkStatusServer(workStatus);\n    return norm === 'onsite' || norm === 'remote';\n  }\n\n  // 4. // 1. Get Manager Scope Staff & Units\n  app.get('/api/manager/scope-staff', authenticateUser, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {\n    try {\n      const supabaseAdmin = res.locals.supabaseAdmin;\n .in('organization_unit_id', Array.from(scopeUnitIds));\n\n      if (mErr) throw mErr;\n\n      // Filter active profiles and deduplicate staff (prefer primary membership)\n      const staffMap = new staffMap.get(m.user_id);\n          if (!existing || (!existing.is_primary && m.is_primary)) {\n            staffMap.set(m.user_id, {\n              user_id: m.user_id,\n              full_name: m.profiles.full_name || 'Ch\u01B0a \u0111\u1EB7t t\u00EAn',\n              employee_code: m.profiles.employee_code || '',\n              email: m.profiles.email || '',\n              job_title: organization_name: m.organization_units?.name || '',\n              organization_code: m.organization_units?.code || '',\n              member_role: m.member_role || 'member',\n              is_primary: !!m.is_primary,\n            });\n          }\n        });\n\n      const staffList = Array.from(staffMap.values()).sort((a, b) =>\n        a.full_name.localeCompare(b.full_name, 'vi')\n      );\n\n      res.json({\n        primary_unit: primaryUnit,\n        scope_units: scopeUnits,\n        staff: staffList,\n      });\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('[API] Error Resolve data scope for team_report.remind\n      const authContext = await getRequestAuthorizationContext(req, res);\n      const dataScope = await resolveDataScope(authContext, 'team_report.remind', supabaseAdmin);\n\n      if (dataScope.kind === 'none') {\n        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden: No data scope for team report reminder.' });\n      }\n\n      const { employee_id, date_from, date_to, idempotency_key } = req.body;\n\n      if (!employee_id || !date_from || !date_to) {\n        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Thi\u1EBFu th\u00F4ng tin b\u1EAFt bu\u1ED9c (employee_id, date_from, date_to).' });\n      }\n\n      // 2. async function canManageAssignment(supabaseAdmin: any, assignment: any, userId: string, profile: any) {\n    if (profile?.system_role === 'admin' || profile?.system_role === 'executive') return true;\n    if (assignment.created_by === userId || assignment.assigned_by === userId) return true;\n    if (profile?.system_role === 'manager') {\n      let targetUnitId = assignment.assignee_organization_unit_id || assignment.assignee_unit_id_snapshot;\n      if (!targetUnitId && assignment.assignee_type === 'individual' && assignment.assignee_user_id) {\n        const { data: member } = await supabaseAdmin.from('organization_members')\n          .select('organization_unit_id')\n          .eq('user_id', assignment.assignee_user_id)\n          .eq('is_primary', true)\n          .maybeSingle();\n        if (member) {\n          targetUnitId = member.organization_unit_id;\n        }\n      }\n      if (targetUnitId) {\n        const { scopeUnitIds } = await resolveManagerScopeUnits(supabaseAdmin, userId, profile.system_role);\n        if (scopeUnitIds.has(targetUnitId)) {\n          return true;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n// Fetch assignment\n    const { data: assignment, error: aErr } = await supabaseAdmin\n      .from('kpi_assignments')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('id', p_assignment_id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (aErr || !assignment) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'assignment_not_found', message: 'Kh\u00F4ng t\u00ECm th\u1EA5y KPI' });\n\n    // 2.
